long_biography.plain_text:
After graduating from Indiana University, Mark S. Elwood joined the employment-testing business his father had established in Columbus, Indiana. As demand for temporary workers grew, he helped turn that local service into Elwood Staffing. His sales focus and leadership through acquisitions carried the firm into new regions, and he eventually became its chief executive.

The company expanded beyond temporary placements into professional recruiting and other workforce services. Elwood later moved to the chairmanship as his brother John took over the chief executive role; the family business remains his central public operating connection. He has also supported community and educational initiatives in his home area, including work with Landmark Columbus Foundation.
